title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on four Sparks
evidence_scope: DSpark5 with NVFP4 draft, probabilistic drafting, block rejection and adaptive verification, Engram tables on disk read before each step, 16 sequences. On installer image dev-20260927-h2dstaging-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031, one installation through `sparkring install` on a four-Spark ring, adopting the checkpoint copies on the Sparks, passed counting, arithmetic, code, tool-call, image and thinking checks; the settings come from a search in serving containers derived from the installer deployment, with two concurrency matrices (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-h2dstaging-deepseek-v41-tp4-20260927.md). On installer image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, an installation of this profile passed the same checks and decoded 63.8 / 196 / 280 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0, with a 64K-token prompt prefilled at 4,284 tokens/s (same record). On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 68.8 / 201 / 277 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 4,406 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-deepseek-v41-flash-tp4-20261001.md). Single-run timing; not serving-qualified.
